JOB DESCRIPTION:

Key responsibilities: 

Project Management 

Lead and facilitate the business case and definition of scope of the project life cycle, work closely with product, marketing, sales, operation teams to achieve business strategic goals via project management methodology.

Break the scope into manageable deliverables, time bound project plan and tracks to completion.

Develop communication plans, organize and facilitate high level project team meetings, promotion clear project objectives alignment, enable effective stakeholder engagement and executive, and improve efficiency in cross-function & cross-regional team collaboration.

Report regular project progress to GM, generate project reports, and follow up project issues and risks.

Assist GM to identify business opportunities and challenges and follow key sales initiatives progress and set up regular review process and agenda

Monitor key product hospital listing and product generation switch progress and adjust product supply forecast accordingly

Lead internal compliance projects, and ongoing compliance monitoring to ensure compliance standards throughout organization.

Lead internal trainings and campaigns progress tracking and ensure all employees complete the tasks on time

Business Planning & Optimization 

Develop forward looking insight about market trends that shape future strategies

Analyze external trends and key implications to overall MedTech industry including market landscape, competitive intelligence, market segmentation, customer insight and regulatory environment; provide insights to facilitate the strategic commercial decisions towards business targets.

Drive process improvement (simplify, automate, leverage scale) & operational excellence activities across functions.

 Work with sub work stream leaders to identify process and policy improvement opportunities and champion a culture of continuous improvement.

 Conduct As-is assessment, gaps identification/ where do we want to get to/ how to get there, execute to-be state.

QUALIFICATIONS AND REQUIREMENTS:

Education/Experience:

BS/BA in Business management, Strategy, Finance, Marketing or similar fields, MBA is perfectible.

Skill requirements:

10+ years’ experience in Marketing, Strategy, Business Planning roles – with emphasis on strategy experience is high preferred.

Demonstrated ability to work effectively across cultures and the agility to deliver results quickly in new and unfamiliar situations.

Proven track record of business experiences and know-hows for growth and mature brands.

Proven track record of project management experiences with influencing skills.

Good understanding of China healthcare industry and market dynamic.

Global view and mindset. Very fluent English communication in both written and oral.

Special skills to be emphasized:

Strategic Agility – Learning agility to develop clear perspectives on the business opportunities and challenges; Ability to think holistically and provide business insights from abundant facts/analysis

Analytical Skill – Excellent ability to review and use data to develop insights and support decisions

Dealing with Ambiguity – Effectively cope with changes; Make decision and act without complete information; Comfortable with risk and uncertainty

Communication and Impact – Excellent presentation and some influencing skill and ability to interact with executives internally and externally.

JOB DESCRIPTION:

As a Professional Sales Manager you will be responsible for the development and performance of all sales strategies in assigned market. Further you will drive primary sales, secondary sales and ensuring brand presence in defined markets. You will supervise/manage the distributor network to achieve desired sales objectives thereby ensuring achievement of financial and ethical objectives of the division as per the business strategy.

To achieve this you will have authority to develop your customer management plan, approve expiry products issue credit note for distributors under your control, recommending appointment and credit limits of distributors, develop, execute & plan your resource utilization and participate in Strategy Execution review meetings to ensure alignment.

You have a very important role to play in Division's success.

Roles and Responsibilities in detail 

Area Business Planning: 

• Plan for monthly and quarterly business.

• Plan for Trade activation business and over all sales

• Plan demand generation and fulfillment

• Monitor actual Sales and mid course corrections and inputs to reduce variance against expectations

• Prescription audit for Abbott brands and other competitors brands

• To create and update customer list having specified number of doctors / chemist (Trade) as per the therapy / product requirement and maintain the same in physical / electronic format.

• Identifying potential town and appointing distributor and customers (trade) in line with business philosophy

Business generation & development: 

• Achieve monthly, quarterly, half yearly and yearly Sales target by promoting companies product ethically to customers as per the business plan

• Having science base discussion with Doctor and chemist for promotion of product in clinic and at chemist place

• Organizing Camps (CME) as per the division strategy and customers need

• To carry out activations across trade and clinics for brand visibility

• To plan and conduct merchandising and sampling activity as per Division strategy.

• Facilitate the process of successful new product / products launch in the territory by undertaking correct identification and targeting customers for the new product, meet them at pre determined intervals, effective in clinic / trade promotion and feed back to the company

• Execute the customer management plan to ensure that all the customers are covered as per the plan and meet minimum KPIs as follows:

a. 100% coverage of Doctors.

b. Customer Call average as per the customer management plan of the division / therapy.

c. Market intelligence collection, retailer level inventory management calls as per the product profile and marketing strategy of the therapy / division.

Brand Management: 

• Ensuring the visibility of Abbott brands on retailers outlet as a part of brand promotion strategy

• To plan and attend Retail meets, Market Blitz etc for sales growth

JOB DESCRIPTION:

About Abbott

Abbott is a global healthcare leader, creating breakthrough science to improve people’s health. We’re always looking towards the future, anticipating changes in medical science and technology.

Working at Abbott

At Abbott, you can do work that matters, grow, and learn, care for yourself and family, be your true self and live a full life. You will have access to:

Career development with an international company where you can grow the career you dream of.

A company recognized as a great place to work in dozens of countries around the world and named one of the most admired companies in the world by Fortune.

A company that is recognized as one of the best big companies to work for as well as a best place to work for diversity, working mothers, female executives, and scientists.

Our nutrition business develops science-based nutrition products for people of all ages, from helping babies and children grow, to keeping adult bodies strong and active. Millions of people around the world count on our leading brands – including Similac®, PediaSure®, Pedialyte®, Ensure®, Glucerna® and ZonePerfect® – to help get the nutrients they need to live their healthiest life.

MAIN PURPOSE OF ROLE

The Channel Development Manager – General Trade (GT) is responsible for shaping and driving the long‑term and short‑term GT channel growth strategy. This role translates deep customer, shopper, and market insights into strategic channel plans and actionable initiatives that accelerate business performance. Acting as a key connector between commercial, marketing, and cross‑functional teams, the incumbent ensures execution excellence across the GT ecosystem while maximizing sales growth, market share, and return on trade investments.

This position is pivotal in unlocking GT channel potential through data‑driven strategies, channel activation frameworks, and best‑in‑class execution that strengthens brand presence, customer engagement, and sustainable competitive advantage.

MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES

1. Strategic Channel Planning & Growth Leadership

Define the GT channel growth drivers and customer/shopper insights to build a comprehensive long-term and short-term GT channel strategy.

Develop strategic GT plans and initiatives that directly support business KPIs, category ambitions, and revenue growth.

Provide strategic inputs that shape broader commercial strategies based on consumer, shopper, and customer requirements within the GT landscape.

 

2. Execution Excellence & Trade Investment Optimization

Develop clear activation and execution guidance to ensure customer-specific plans align with the overarching GT channel strategy.

Lead the design of tailored trade promotions, visibility plans, and activation activities that maximize impact and ROI.

Monitor sales performance, market share, and investment efficiency to optimize trade spending and resource allocation.

 

3. Brand & Business Initiative Deployment

Translate channel growth drivers and shopper insights into brand-specific and business-focused action plans.

Lead the development and implementation of OMNI-channel initiatives that elevate customer engagement and accelerate GT channel performance.

Ensure alignment between GT channel plans and brand strategies to deliver holistic, impactful market execution.

 

4. Cross-Functional Collaboration & Business Partnership

Work closely with Sales, Finance, Marketing, DMS, Business Development, O2O teams, etc… to co-create and execute channel strategies.

Act as a strategic partner to Sales by providing clear direction, insights, and materials that drive execution excellence at the point of purchase.

Facilitate strong cross-functional communication to ensure seamless delivery of GT initiatives and business results.

 

5. Market Intelligence & Competitive Insight

Continuously track and analyze channel trends, competitive activities, and emerging opportunities to inform strategic adjustments.

Communicate market developments and implications to stakeholders, providing expert recommendations to strengthen category and brand advantage.

 

6. Champion of GT Channel Projects

Lead high-impact GT projects including customer loyalty programs, visibility upgrades, and in-store activation initiatives.

Ensure all GT projects are delivered with best-in-class execution, measurable outcomes, and alignment to channel growth priorities.

QUALIFICATIONS

Education Level

Bachelor degree of Business Administration or any related field

Experience Details

Bachelor's degree in business, Economic, Marketing, Trade

Minimum 5+ year experience with outstanding performance in Trade Marketing/ Shopper Marketing/ Customer Marketing/ Brand Marketing/GT Sales

Record of success in Trade Marketing and GT Channel, especially in customer-facing roles

Ability to engage and work with cross functions

Winning mindset

Result Oriented, passionate, resilient, persistent, able to handle high levels of pressure

Excellent interpersonal skills

Time management

Learning agility

Good command of English

This role is the senior commercial leader responsible for driving profitable top‑line growth of approx. $330MM through a key strategic alliance. In Abbott’s Electrophysiology (EP) business, we’re advancing the treatment of heart disease through breakthrough medical technologies in atrial fibrillation, allowing people to restore their health and get on with their lives.

Individuals in this role will work supporting the operations team within our injection molding engineering group as a front-line engineer working with assemblers and troubleshooting equipment and process issues. Additionally, this position will manage projects aimed towards designing and developing manufacturing processes, tooling, and fixtures to meet daily production schedules while enhancing productivity and product quality.

Front line engineer supporting operations team

Individual should:

Our Neuromodulation business includes implantable devices compatible with mobile technology to help people who suffer from chronic pain and movement disorders. These non-opioid therapies allow us to provide interventional pain therapy to patients throughout the pain continuum.

Structural Heart

Structural Heart Business Mission: why we exist

Our business purpose is to restore health and improve quality of life through the design and provision of device and management solutions for the treatment of structural heart disease.

EP

In Abbott’s Electrophysiology (EP) business, we’re advancing the treatment of heart disease through breakthrough medical technologies in atrial fibrillation, allowing people to restore their health and get on with their lives.

HF

In Abbott’s Heart Failure (HF) business, we’re developing solutions to diagnose, monitor and manage heart failure, allowing people to restore their health and get on with their lives.

Diagnostics

We’re empowering smarter medical and economic decision making to help transform the way people manage their health at all stages of life. Every day, more than 10 million tests are run on Abbott’s diagnostics instruments, providing lab results for millions of people.

Abbott Molecular is a leader in molecular diagnostics and the analysis of DNA, RNA, and proteins at the molecular level.

Our Point of Care diagnostic portfolio spans key heath and therapeutic areas, including infections disease, cardiometabolic, informatics and toxicology.

Our diagnostic solutions are used in hospitals, laboratories and clinics around the globe. The crucial information derived from our tests, instruments and informatics systems are often the first step in patient care decision making for hundreds of health conditions from heart attacks to blood disorders to infectious diseases and cancers.

Our rapid diagnostics solutions are helping address some of the world’s greatest healthcare challenges.

Nutrition

Our nutrition business develops science-based nutrition products for people of all ages, from helping babies and children grow to keeping adult bodies strong and active. Millions of people around the world count on our leading brands – including Similac®, PediaSure®, Pedialyte®, Ensure®, and Glucerna® – to help them get the nutrients they need to live their healthiest lives.

时间管理：

每月区域协访，与当地代表、地区经理一起工作10-15天，共同讨论市场发展、销售计划、解决实地一些问题。

每月至少参加1-2次地区会议，并给予地区经理指导。

每季至少参加一次地区经理给代表所做的绩效评估并对地区经理给予反馈与指导。

每月同地区经理和区域市场经理进行生意回顾并讨论团队代表的报表，给予建议。

每月与中央市场部进行沟通，就大区相关问题进行讨论。

每月与大区商务经理、KA经理进行面对面沟通，就大区相关问题进行讨论。

每月与大区培训经理进行面对面沟通，就大区培训计划进行讨论。

每月至少同地区经理拜访重要客户10人。

每月检查代表/地区经理工作状况。

销售管理：

每半年根据公司下达的销售指标，根据指标分配程序及各地区销售情况，合理地将指标分配给地区经理。

根据地区经理所做的销售规划，每月进行跟踪，并及时修正、改进计划。

根据公司策略以及大区具体情况，制定出大区重点产品发育计划，并协助地区经理制定市场活动计划。

About Abbott

Abbott is a global healthcare leader who is creating breakthrough science to improve people’s health. We always look towards the future, anticipating medical science and technology changes. We are dedicated to expanding access to our trusted medicines in some of the world's fastest-growing countries. Our extensive portfolio includes high-quality, differentiated branded generic medicines that cover various therapeutic areas, such as gastroenterology, women's health, cardiometabolic health, pain management/central nervous system disorders, and respiratory diseases.

Working at Abbott 

At Abbott, you can do work that matters, grow and learn, care for yourself and your family, be your true self and live a whole life. You will have access to: 

Career development with an international company where you can grow your dream career.

A company recognized as a great place to work in dozens of countries worldwide and named one of the most admired companies by Fortune. 

A company recognized as one of the best big companies to work for and the best place for diverse working mothers, female executives, and scientists. 

The Opportunity 

The Head of Trade is a key member of the leadership team in FAC , based in Algeria within the Established Pharmaceutical Division.

As the Trade head at Abbott EPD FAC, you will shape and execute our trade vision and strategy, leading the Trade teams across FAC . You will foster an integrated Trade , creating innovative value propositions and digital solutions to establish Abbott as the most reputable partner for trade customers and build strategic relationships with them.

You will be accountable for managing the financial objectives of the trade team, driving profitable growth, and enhancing brand visibility and recommendation rates by optimizing local trade structures, driving operational efficiency, adapting global projects, strengthening brand presence, implementing SOPs and best practices, coordinating with cross-functional teams, and overseeing inventory levels.

Additionally, you will identify new trade opportunities, monitor market conditions, and adjust trade strategies. Ensuring high levels of customer satisfaction.

Key Responsibilities: 

Operational Strategic Leadership:

Develop and implement a Trade strategy in the cluster to optimise trade in all channels, aligned with the Global Strategy, market dynamics, and local objectives.

Create value proposition projects to boost sell-out and drive profitable growth in Trade & e-commerce channels, cross-functionally aligned with the country’s vision and strategy across the FAC cluster 

Execute innovative Trade Marketing tactics such as merchandising recommendations, materials, and patient support programs to enhance Abbott’s brand availability, visibility, and recommendation rates.

Collaborate with local and regional Brand Marketing Teams, identify the brand's priorities, and bring field insights to translate brand strategy into Trade initiatives.

Enhance local trade structures to match market potential and optimize the route to market.

Adapt global projects to maximize brand performance across channels and build pharmacy advocacy.

Strengthen brand presence in all channels to increase brand and corporate SOV, improving visibility and monitoring progress.

Negotiate with key accounts to ensure trade support & customized offerings.

Map the pharmacy market landscape.

Coordinate locally with Marketing and Sales to roll out marketing initiatives such as new launches, new trade channels, and promotional campaigns.

Relationship Management across FAC Cluster 

Establish and maintain strategic relationships with key trade customers, distributors, wholesalers, and pharmacies.

Liaise with key purchasers in retail pharmacies and wholesalers, optimizing services to benefit Abbott.

Train and support pharmacy staff to enhance their capabilities and ensure consistent product messaging.

Conduct quarterly business reviews with key customers to assess performance and identify growth opportunities.

Financial and Performance Management:

Set and manage the annual budget aligned with sales and marketing for key accounts, ensuring expenditures stay within plan.

Establish and monitor KPIs for key activities, driving corrective actions to achieve financial objectives as needed.

Develop and manage the trade budget, ensuring efficient resource allocation.

Analyze sales data, market trends, and competitor activities to identify improvement areas and drive growth.

Prepare performance reports to senior management, providing actionable insights and recommendations.

Operational Efficiency and Inventory Management:

Optimize Trade operations using data analytics, automation & advanced technology solutions when applicable. 

Implement SOPs and best practices to enhance operational efficiency, reduce costs, and improve performance metrics.

Coordinate with cross-functional teams to ensure seamless operations and alignment with objectives.

Oversee inventory levels to ensure timely product availability, collaborating with distributors and stakeholders to optimize supply chain operations, minimize stockouts, and manage inventory costs.

Develop and implement a demand forecasting model to maintain safe inventory stocks.

Compliance and Quality Assurance:

Ensure compliance of all trade activities with relevant Acts, legal demands, trade standards, and Corporate Business and Safety procedures.

Address and resolve compliance issues promptly to avoid supply chain disruptions.

Market Research Strategy:

Conduct market research to identify new trade opportunities, emerging trends, and competitive landscapes.

Monitor market conditions and adjust trade strategies to maintain a competitive advantage

Team Leadership:

Play a crucial role in shaping Abbott FAC's trade vision, strategy, and leadership as an integral member of the country's leadership team.

Oversee, coach, and develop the Abbott-EPD Trade teams (Sales, Marketing, and E-commerce when applicable ) across FAC, ensuring they achieve their professional development goals. Foster seamless and integrated business planning while promoting a culture of continuous improvement and high performance.

Cultivate and enhance the trade marketing mindset and capabilities of the Abbott-EPD Trade sales team to build strong relationships with key customers.

Customer Satisfaction:

Ensure timely and accurate order fulfilment to meet customer expectations.

Promptly resolve pharmacy-related issues to maintain high levels of customer satisfaction.

Implement customer feedback mechanisms to improve service quality continuously.

Qualifications:

Education:

Bachelor's degree in pharmaceutical Science, Business or a related field.

Advanced degrees or certifications in business administration, Marketing, Sales, public health, health economics, or health policy are advantageous.

Experience

Must have experience managing trade/ channel management with Distributors across North and west Africa market.

Extensive experience and leadership positions in managing sales, marketing (at least 2 years), Customer excellence, or logistics, preferably Trade marketing and OTC management experience within the pharmaceutical industry, and expertise in inventory systems.

In-depth industry knowledge gained from experience in a multinational company.

Kom bij ons team als Allround Monteur in een 5-ploegendienst!

 

Wat ga je doen?

Stap in een technisch uitdagende en complexe omgeving binnen onze fabriek, waar je nauw samenwerkt met collega-monteurs en operators. Jij bent dé specialist van de productieploeg voor preventief en correctief onderhoud aan de lijn. Jouw bijdrage is cruciaal voor de betrouwbaarheid van onze technische bedrijfsinstallaties.

 

Past jouw profiel niet helemaal bij wat wij vragen? Geen probleem! Solliciteer toch, zodat we jou kunnen helpen met jouw ontwikkeling!

Wat worden je belangrijkste taken en verantwoordelijkheden?

Preventief onderhoud uitvoeren aan bedrijfsinstallaties tijdens geplande stilstanden.

Verstoringen verhelpen in zowel mechanische als elektrotechnische disciplines na melding van de interne klant, en aangeven hoeveel tijd nodig is om de problemen op te lossen.

Dagelijks storingen en onderhoudswerkzaamheden registreren in het onderhoudssysteem en benodigde onderhoudslijsten uitdraaien.

Communiceren met lijnoperators en ploegenmonteurs over lopende zaken en de Technical Specialist ondersteunen bij Rootcause Analyse op technisch vlak.

Aanbevelingen doen voor Demand Maintenance of optimalisatie aan de Technical Specialist op basis van analyses van technische storingen.

Samenwerken met andere monteurs en zorgen voor een goede werkverdeling en overdracht van taken.

Initiatief nemen en voorstellen doen voor verbeteringen van apparatuur of onderhoudsprogramma’s ten behoeve van kwaliteit en efficiency.

Contractors en externe specialisten begeleiden.

Toezicht houden op de naleving van bedrijfs- en veiligheidsvoorschriften.

Actief de tijd benutten om machines en apparatuur te observeren met als doel optimalisatie.

 

Wat zoeken wij?

Een MBO-opleiding richting Elektronica/Mechatronica of een vergelijkbare opleiding op niveau 4.

Ruime ervaring binnen een productieomgeving, bij voorkeur in de voedsel- en/of farmaceutische industrie.

Ruime kennis en werkervaring op een van de technische vakgebieden (mechanisch, elektrisch of besturing (PLC)) en in staat om vrijwel alle complexe storingen zelfstandig op te lossen. VCA-gecertificeerd.

Een echte vakman/vrouw die zich bewust is van de hoge eisen die aan onderhoud worden gesteld in deze industrie.

Open en duidelijke communicatie, leergierig, flexibel en stressbestendig.

 

Wat hebben wij jou te bieden?

Een goed salaris.

Een Individueel Keuzebudget (IKB) met vakantietoeslag, 13e maand, bijzonder verlof en extra vakantiedagen.

 

Hoe solliciteer je?

Ben je geïnteresseerd in deze vacature en herken je jezelf in het bovenstaande profiel? Solliciteer dan met je CV en motivatie via onze website. Voor meer informatie kun je contact opnemen met Meltem Cakir, Recruiter, via recruitment.netherlands@abbott.com. Onderdeel van onze selectieprocedure is het nagaan van referenties en het overleggen van een Verklaring Omtrent Gedrag. Daarnaast kan een assessment center onderdeel uitmaken van het sollicitatieproces.We kijken uit naar je sollicitatie!

Abbott là công ty chăm sóc sức khỏe toàn cầu, tiên phong trong nghiên cứu khoa học và tạo ra những đột phá trong công nghệ chăm sóc sức khỏe để giúp mọi người sống khỏe mạnh hơn. Chúng tôi luôn hướng tới tương lai, dự đoán và đáp ứng những thay đổi trong khoa học và công nghệ y khoa. LÀM VIỆC TẠI ABBOTTTại Abbott, bạn có thể làm công việc tạo ra giá trị và ý nghĩa cho cộng đồng. Bạn được trao cơ hội để học hỏi và phát triển, chăm sóc bản thân và gia đình, đồng

thời thể hiện và phát huy tối đa tiềm năng của bản thân trong cả sự nghiệp và cuộc sống. Bạn sẽ có cơ hội:

Phát triển sự nghiệp tại một công ty toàn cầu, nơi bạn có thể hiện thực hóa ước mơ nghề nghiệp của mình.

Làm việc tại một môi trường được công nhận là “Nơi làm việc tốt nhất” tại nhiều quốc gia và được tạp chí Fortune (Mỹ) vinh danh là một trong những công ty được ngưỡng mộ nhất thế giới.

Trở thành một phần của doanh nghiệp hàng đầu, được công nhận là nơi làm việc tốt nhất với môi trường tuyệt vời cho sự đa dạng và hòa nhập.

Địa điểm: Thanh Hóa

2. Quản lý đội ngũ PG (Promotion Girls) – 20-35 người tại các Key Shops Sắp xếp lịch làm việc, phân công khu vực và giám sát hiệu quả làm việc của PGs. Đề xuất tuyển dụng, đào tạo và huấn luyện PGs mới. Kiểm tra định kỳ hoạt động của PGs tại điểm bán, đảm bảo tuân thủ quy trình và hình ảnh thương hiệu.

Qué harás:

Coordinar y conciliar los inputs del forecast entre Comercial, Marketing, Supply y Finanzas Garantizar que toda la información ingresada al proceso (promociones, lanzamientos, planes comerciales, proyecciones financieras) sea consistente, esté alineada y sin duplicidades, actuando como punto central de conexión entre áreas.

Dar seguimiento a riesgos de inventario derivados del forecast, como Stock at Risk (SAR), Monitorear el impacto del pronóstico en niveles de inventario, identificando posibles excesos, cortos y riesgos de expiración, y coordinando con Supply y Comercial para definir acciones preventivas.

Consolidar y documentar acuerdos clave del ciclo de demanda, registrar decisiones, cambios realizados y compromisos asumidos por las áreas durante el proceso de consenso, asegurando trazabilidad y claridad en la evolución del forecast.

Deseable conocimiento de Power BI.

Our Abbott story is one of delivering bold solutions in the face of complex healthcare challenges. When you join Abbott EP, you become part of a passionate group of individuals who are dedicated to driving the EP space forward and helping people live longer, fuller lives. What You’ll Work On

Working under general direction, provides engineering, sales, educational and technical support in response to field inquiries from physicians, health care professionals, patients, and field sales staff, involving EP products. Identifies and routinely uses the most effective, cost efficient and best business practices to execute processes; continually evaluates their effectiveness and appropriateness. Exercises independent judgment in planning, organizing and performing work; monitors performance and reports status to manager.

Gaining foundational knowledge of EP through a structured training program with a strong emphasis on hands-on learning and practical application.

Acting as a clinical interface between the medical community and the business. 

Demonstrating the ability to build and sustain credible clinical relationships with customers and sharing product expertise accordingly. 

Demonstrating a thorough command of all EP products, including technical details, software utilization, and capabilities. 

Providing engineering, sales, education, and clinical support on the safe and effective use of Abbott EP products, including cardiac mapping, diagnostic, and therapy systems. 

Supporting EP Sales Representatives in the following areas: 

Collaborating with sales personnel; 

Facilitating regional training seminars; 

Participating in clinical studies/data collection; 

Troubleshooting; and, 

Leading/supporting new product in-service trainings and/or demonstrations to physicians, nurses, and sales representatives. 

Continuously develops engineering, sales and technical skills aligned with the overall territory strategy, including learning from senior sales personnel and management. 

Staying up-to-date on the latest industry developments, regulatory requirements, and maintains strong knowledge of company and competitor products, market trends, and strategic goals. 

Providing management with feedback on market trends and customer insights to inform strategic decisions and guide next-generation product development.

The Opportunity

Lead end-to-end vendor management for the benefits administration vendor (Businessolver) and all point solution partners, ensuring seamless cross vendor integration, service excellence, and measurable performance outcomes.

Translate health and welfare benefit strategy into operational execution, partnering with vendors to align KPIs, identify improvement opportunities, and deliver consistent, high-quality employee and retiree experiences.

Own Open Enrollment (OE) strategy and governance, including planning, stakeholder alignment, vendor coordination, communication frameworks, and execution readiness.

Review and approve employee facing benefit communications developed by Businessolver and point solution vendors.

Ensure consistent, coordinated messaging across internal channels (HRIS/HRSC, Payroll, Communications) and external vendor platforms.

JOB DESCRIPTION:

Annonce Recherche Alternant(e) : Adjoint Manager HSE

Abbott s’attache à développer le rôle primordial de la santé. Depuis plus de 125 ans, Abbott aide les gens à exploiter pleinement leur potentiel - car une meilleure santé permet aux personnes et aux communautés d’accomplir davantage. Grâce à un réseau mondial diversifié, desservant des clients dans plus de 160 pays, nous créons de nouvelles solutions qui couvrent tous les secteurs de la santé, partout dans le monde, et à toutes les étapes de la vie. Qu’il s’agisse de la prochaine génération d’outils de diagnostic, de dispositifs destinés à changer la vie, de nutrition reposant sur des fondements scientifiques ou de nouvelles reformulations, nous développons certaines des technologies les plus innovantes et révolutionnaires dans le domaine des soins de santé, en aidant les gens à améliorer leur vie grâce à une meilleure santé.

Objectif principal du poste:

Contribuer au développement et à la mise en œuvre du programme Environnement, Santé et Sécurité (HSE) pour les activités commerciales en France. Les éléments du programme HSE incluent la sécurité des conducteurs, l’enquête sur les incidents, la biosécurité et les agents pathogènes transmissibles par le sang, l’ergonomie, la préparation aux situations d’urgence, la communication des dangers, la radioprotection, la santé au travail.

Responsabilités principales:

Contribuer à la mise en conformité vis-à-vis des réglementations du Corporate, des divisions et de la législation française relatives à l’environnement, la santé et la sécurité.

Mettre en place et suivre les formations et les communications HSE.

Interagir avec les services du Corporate, les divisions et les organismes/agences française concernant les questions de sécurité, d’environnement et de santé.

Identifier et quantifier les risques HSE et leurs conséquences par rapport aux objectifs globaux de l’entreprise et recommander des actions appropriées. Reconnaître et répondre aux directions, aux conditions du marché, aux obligations réglementaires, etc., évaluer et intégrer les informations pour définir les effets bénéfiques sur l’entreprise.

Contribuer aux évaluations des risques et des réglementations HSE.

Aider les filiales à se préparer aux audits HSE (réglementaires, internes, etc.) et aux certifications HSE telles que l’ISO 14001.

Réaliser des revues pré-audit des normes HSE applicables.

Mettre en œuvre des programmes pour se conformer aux normes HSE applicables.

Présenter le programme HSE pour audit/inspection.

Aider à l’élaboration d’un plan d’action pour traiter les conclusions de l’audit.

Veiller à ce que les conclusions de l’audit soient résolues conformément au plan d’action.

Contribuer à la gestion accidents et maladies liées au travail.

Veiller à ce que tous les accidents soient signalés rapidement et fassent l’objet d’une enquête approfondie.

Veiller à ce qu’un plan d’action correctif soit élaboré pour prévenir la récurrence d’incidents similaires.

Contribuer à la gestion du programme de sécurité des conducteurs, y compris

Veiller à ce que les dossiers de conduite ou l’équivalent soient complétés pour tous les conducteurs éligibles.

Veiller à ce que les conducteurs à risque soient identifiés et que des formations prévention routière soient dispensées.

Veiller à la coordination de la formation pratique des nouveaux embauchés.

Veiller à la coordination et à la réalisation des formations de recyclage prévention routière.

Mettre en œuvre des initiatives pour améliorer et faire progresser continuellement la sécurité des conducteurs.

Contribuer à la remontée des données d’accidents de la route, des km et de la consommation de carburant

Veiller à ce que tous les accidents de la route fassent l’objet d’une enquête.

Contribuer à la mise en œuvre des programmes de radioprotection, de biosécurité, d’ergonomie, de préparation aux situations d’urgence, de communication des dangers et de santé au travail.

Formation:

Idéalement Diplôme master ou licence en sécurité, santé, sciences de l’environnement, technique ou diplôme universitaire avec une appétence pour l’HSE.

About Abbott

Abbott, a global leader in healthcare, is investing in Mexico. We are building a manufacturing facility in Querétaro.

In Abbott’s Electrophysiology (EP) business, we advance the treatment of heart disease through breakthrough medical technologies for atrial fibrillation, helping people restore their health and live their lives fully.

This facility will create 1,200 new local jobs and will be the first healthcare manufacturing facility in Querétaro, positioning the region as a healthcare hub pioneer.

Working at Abbott

Career development with an international company where you can build the career you dream of.

The Opportunity

This position is based in Querétaro within our Electrophysiology (EP) division, where we are advancing the treatment of heart disease through innovative medical technologies for atrial fibrillation, enabling people to restore their health and move forward with their lives.

What You’ll Do

Responsible to ensure materials, services, and supplies used in the Facility are procured at competitive pricing and that quality/quantities are appropriate. This may include obtaining price quotes, specifications and other information required for purchasing decisions. May also include supplier performance tracking and reporting. Locates, recommends and supports implementation of alternative supply in line with requirements.

Main Responsibilities

Negotiates long term contracts which are not managed by the commodity management teams, within established limitations and scope of authority to obtain the most favorable business partnerships, including but not limited to quality, availability and cost.  

Plans and schedules deliveries to optimize inventories in support of production schedules/business demands by working with forecasting data/teams, planning teams, commodity teams and Shipping/Receiving teams.  

Reviews purchase requisitions and confers with vendors to obtain product information such as price, availability and delivery schedule, reviewing quotes for accuracy and competitive strategies  Reviews and monitors scrap material to identify systemic problems. Participates in departmental meetings to share information regarding status and condition of production materials and related, and/or new developments. 

Facilitates vendor corrective action and partners with SQE and suppliers to improve quality. 

Participates in Research and Development meetings, developing and implementing action plans to Support requirements bringing new products expeditiously to market. 

Recommends pricing strategies to achieve department operating goals. 

Creates and maintains mutually beneficial long-term partnerships with suppliers to foster feedback and continuous improvement, usually being the single source of contact for the vendor. 

Investigates and recommends new vendors. 

Performs as purchasing subject matter expert for internal and external customers due to extensive knowledge of purchasing and product line operations. 

Provides coaching and mentoring to junior members of the purchasing team.

Monitors supplier performance, communicates and takes action to maintain high levels of supplier performance. Maintains and updates supplier databases as required. 

Generates highly complex reports and performs data analysis to proactively plan or resolve issues. 

Works with inventory management/warehouse management to resolve issues.  

Lead special projects as requested to reduce cost, increase efficiency, etc

Required Qualifications

Proven experience in direct material purchasing in manufacturing environments (minimum 5 years, 4 as Senior Buyer) 

Includes capacity analysis, volume planning, and supplier management.

Advanced SAP expertise (purchasing) 

Ability to execute transactions, generate reports, cancel orders, and manage critical information. Currently Using Modules ME11, ME12, M23N, M2L, MD04, MB51

Advanced English proficiency (fluent business communication) 

Constant interaction with U.S. teams and international suppliers.

Strategic and analytical skills to ensure supply and optimize processes 

Includes development of business cases, risk analysis, and improvement proposals.

Solid experience in direct material purchasing (raw materials, critical components) 

Deep knowledge of the industry and supply chain.

Preferred Qualifications

Strong knowledge and ability to review SAP transactions..

Proficiency in SAP, specifically MRP processes.

Solid background in purchasing and procurement.

Verifiable English skills, at least at a conversational level.

Ability to go beyond purely operational tasks, demonstrating strong analytical skills, information interpretation, and sound decision‑making.

Capability to develop follow‑up plans, establish clear and measurable strategies, and execute them consistently.

The Role 

The Quality Operations Manager provides strategic leadership for all quality documentation, batch release, and compliance activities within the Casa Grande manufacturing site. This role ensures the integrity of the site’s Quality Management System (QMS) while guiding QA teams to deliver safe, compliant products that meet Abbott and regulatory standards. 

 

WHAT YOU’LL DO 

Manage QA teams responsible for quality documentation accuracy, batch record review, and product release within a manufacturing environment. 

Implement, maintain, and continuously improve the site Quality Management System (QMS) to ensure compliance with Abbott policies, divisional requirements, and applicable regulatory standards. 

Lead end to end batch documentation review, evaluating compliance, CAPA, interventions, and environmental monitoring data prior to batch release. 

Own the Batch Release process, managing nonconformances, initiating corrective actions, controlling product release, and coordinating quarantine of nonconforming product. 

Develop and monitor key quality metrics to track compliance, operational performance, and QMS effectiveness, using data to identify trends and drive continuous improvement. 

Review and approve site documentation change requests, assess corporate/divisional policy updates, and ensure aligned change control across impacted functions. 

Support new product introductions, ensuring documentation, label copy adherence, training, and certification requirements are met. 

Maintain the site documentation and QA Work Order systems, ensuring documents meet Abbott and regulatory standards and are stored in compliant, efficient systems. 

Serve as the site Quality System Management Representative and participate as a member of the site senior leadership team. 

Select, train, develop, and mentor QA staff to support current and future business needs and all elements of the QMS. 

Develop and maintain a culture where Health & Safety is an individual and collective responsibility; address H&S concerns and reduce risk within areas of responsibility. 

Manage CAPA processes including nonconformances, audit findings, and customer complaints; support field action activities when applicable. 

Ensure compliance with applicable local and international regulations for markets served, including evaluation of new regulations and their impact on the business. 

Lead QA personnel to achieve site and divisional objectives while upholding Abbott’s Code of Conduct and high standards of communication and professional behavior. 

Drive strong customer service within QA processes while maintaining regulatory and quality compliance. 

Support cost improvement initiatives and division driven programs without compromising quality or compliance. 

Manage QA resource planning and associated budget requirements (expense and capital).

Strong decision making ability with proven experience evaluating risk and business impact with limited information.

Ability to work effectively in a highly matrixed organization and partner across functions.

Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to communicate clearly at multiple levels in the organization.

The Opportunity 

Abbott Rapid Diagnostics is part of Abbott’s Diagnostics family of businesses, bringing together exceptional teams of experts and industry leading technologies to support diagnostic testing which provides important information for treatment and management of diseases and other conditions.

The position of Senior Manufacturing Process Engineer is within our Infectious Disease Developed Markets business unit located at Scarborough, Maine. In this role you will support all Manufacturing Equipment and equipment quality/cost savings initiatives, improving efficiency through material and process improvement, reducing material processing costs, and participating in new product design.

What You’ll Work On

Owns and is responsible for processes based on product specifications and in consideration to process and test method capabilities

Evaluates and drives process and design alternatives based on Design for Manufacturability (DFM) principles.

Solves highly technical and complex problems using problem solving and statistical tools and make sound design recommendations.

Manages program compliance with Quality requirements (i.e. Design Control, Process validation etc.).

Maintains knowledge of new developments in manufacturing and design technologies.

Can identify and propose and own solutions for work environment issues (i.e. OSHA regulations, etc.).

Supports all Company initiatives as identified by management and in support of Quality Management Systems (QMS), Environmental Management Systems (EMS), and other regulatory requirements.

Designs and leads tests, collects anaylzes and formats data, supporting engineering studies (DOEs).

Engages in start up of new equipment, defining and executiing validation protocols based on requirements.

Communicates effectively and participate on cross functional development teams.

Leads in technical design reviews for process equipment and product design and requirements documents.

Responsible for utilizing and maintaining the effectiveness of the quality system, including supporting Quality Incidents and CAPA investigations and actions.

Analyzes raw material specifications to ensure appropriate features and limits are in place to support company manufacturing process.

Evaluates and owns change actions assocaited with company initiated raw material changes and coordinates appropriate testing and validation as required.

Works to reduce costs in all areas of manufacturing by analyzing current equipment for process suitability and provides detailed plans for improvement.

Creates and revises manufacturing documents, specifications, standard operating procedures (SOPs), safety instructions, validation protocols, risk assessments, and procedures and other technical documents to insure compliant, efficient and safe processes.

Conducts operational procedure audits to ensure compliance with SOPs, ISO, FDA and cGMP requirements.

Researches engineering solutions to a diverse set of challenges in production and development.

Complies with U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) regulations, other regulatory requirements, Company policies, operating procedures, processes, and task assignments.

Mentors junior engineers and maintenance technicians to ensure continual improvement, safety, and compliance.

Leads change through Agile PDM.

Required Qualifications

Bachelor's degree (BS) in Engineering or equivalent combination of education and experience.

7+ years engineering experience in a manufacturing environment.

Technical experience in mechanical, biomedical, industrial or chemical engineering.

Experience in performing engineering calculations, controlled tests, statistical analyses.

Experience in Microsoft Suites software. (Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, Power BI, etc.) 

Experience with change management principles and practices.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

Proficient with cGMP and ISO 13485 regulations and practices.

Proficient with statistical analysis software. (Minitab or JMP preferred)

Provides technical, clinical, and programming assistance, primarily in support of 1-2 Territory Manager(s). 

Assist Territory Managers in after-hours call support and activities. 

Integrates into all accounts, builds trust and relationships, and establishes strong rapport with customers.

Works seamlessly with Territory Manager(s) allowing them increased selling time.

May attend trade shows where new products and technologies are showcased and conferences to meet other sales representatives and clients and discuss new product developments.

Strong clinical skills. 

Excellent organizational, time management and prioritizing skills. 

Excellent interpersonal verbal, written and presentation skills with ability to effectively communicate at multiple levels and to large groups within and outside the organization.

Accustomed to tight deadlines and managing multiple tasks.

Strong sense of urgency.

Ability to leverage and/or engage others to accomplish projects.

Multitasks, prioritizes, and meets deadlines in timely manner.

Analyze, interpret and implement customer pricing contracts timely to ensure accurate pricing for customers. Ensure compliance in contracting and pricing to ethical procedures. Provide cross-functional support to develop and drive sound contracting and pricing strategies. Lead and influence both with and without direct authority.

What You’ll Do

Ensure compliance relative to contracting and pricing contracts against departmental Office of Ethics and Compliance (OEC) procedures.

Manage and develop contracting and pricing strategies as well as the review and implementation of contract paperwork within a defined market segment.

Work cross-functionally to resolve problems and accomplish goals.

Act as a consultant and subject matter expert (SME) relative to customer contract language, terms and conditions.

Perform customer pricing audits/reviews.

Facilitate and implement new customer set up requirements regarding pricing structure.

Respond to requests from Sales team and other internal customers to review/correct pricing concerns in a timely manner; measured by resolution rate.

Participate in process improvement initiatives, utilizing experience to suggest means for improving operational efficiency and effectiveness.

Travel up to 10% of the time both domestically and internationally by any means necessary to support organizational goals.

Demonstrating continual improvement in matters concerning contracting and pricing.

Required Qualifications

7+ years of applicable experience, knowledge of and ability to apply contracting and pricing strategies to business-specific operations.

Ability to understand the organization's strategy and translate this into day-to-day contracting and pricing activities.

Experience working with sales or in a sales environment.

Ability to facilitate interpretation and understanding of data, identify risks, develop recommendations and implement solutions.

This position works out of our Mexico City, Tlalpan Site in the Abbott Global Security Division.

About the Role

The Regional Security Manager plays a key role in supporting Abbott’s commitment to safeguarding our people, products, and operations across a diverse and evolving risk environment. This position leads regional security operations, advances Abbott’s Global Security (GS) strategy, and ensures consistent protection standards across manufacturing sites, commercial offices, supply‑chain nodes, and field operations. The role requires strong leadership, deep expertise in corporate security within a global organization, and the ability to collaborate effectively with cross‑functional teams supporting Abbott’s healthcare mission.

Key Responsibilities

Lead and oversee day‑to‑day regional security operations, ensuring alignment with Abbott Global Security (GS) policies, programs, and enterprise risk priorities.

Develop and execute regional security goals, protocols, and operational plans that support Abbott’s strategic objectives and enable business continuity across manufacturing, logistics, commercial, and R&D environments.

Review, refine, and implement security procedures designed to protect employees, facilities, high‑value products, supply‑chain activity, and sensitive operational assets.

Conduct ongoing assessments of threats, vulnerabilities, and operational risks impacting Abbott sites, field teams, and distribution channels; implement mitigation measures based on findings.

Monitor regional disruptions, including crime trends, civil unrest, natural hazards, and geopolitical developments, and coordinate response strategies with local business leaders and global security partners.

Serve as the regional lead for major security events, coordinating closely with Abbott leadership, cross‑functional teams, external security partners, and local law enforcement as required.

Oversee and conduct investigations related to threats, security incidents, potential product diversion, and workplace violence matters, ensuring timely and actionable reporting.

Design and deliver security training programs to strengthen preparedness, employee awareness, and adherence to Abbott security standards.

Produce after‑action reports following security events and coordinate implementation of follow‑up actions or corrective measures.

Communicate security matters clearly and effectively to senior leaders, providing insights that support informed decision‑making across corporate, manufacturing, and supply‑chain functions.

Evaluate, select, and manage security vendors and contracted guarding services to ensure high‑quality, compliant, and cost‑effective performance.

Strengthen internal processes, governance, and audit readiness across regional operations to reduce risk and support Abbott’s compliance and quality commitments.

Lead special security projects in support of Abbott Global Security initiatives or business‑driven requirements.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree or equivalent professional experience; advanced degree preferred.

15+ years of experience in security, risk management, or operations within a corporate or global organization.

Demonstrated experience as a Security Manager with strong leadership capability in complex, high‑risk, or multinational environments.

Expertise in operational security, physical security, travel security, crisis management, and workplace violence prevention within a corporate or manufacturing context.

Proven experience developing and implementing security plans, crisis‑management frameworks, investigative processes, and incident‑response protocols.

Strong background in incident reporting, threat assessments, and risk analytics.

Ability to influence senior leaders and collaborate effectively across global, cross‑functional teams including Supply Chain, HR, Manufacturing, Quality, Legal, and Communications.

Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with strong presentation and reporting capabilities.

High‑level judgment and decision‑making skills, with the ability to lead during high‑pressure situations.

Experience selecting, managing, and evaluating external security partners, including guarding and investigative vendors.

Willingness to travel within the region and internationally as required.

Bilingual (English and Spanish) required, with the ability to operate confidently across multicultural environments.

JOB DESCRIPTION:

The Corporate Engineering (CE) organization is looking for an experienced and motivated individual to serve as Fire Protection Program Manager. This opportunity is for someone who wants to positively impact the organization in a meaningful role that applies advanced engineering knowledge and experience, combined with a disciplined project management approach, to deliver business solutions that span across divisions and regions. A part of Global Engineering Services (GES), Corporate Engineering exists to support Abbott’s businesses and help them drive sustainable growth and margin improvement. Corporate Engineering does this by planning, designing and deploying Facilities, Utilities & Infrastructure projects with excellence, by means of strong talent, best practices, resourcefulness, and experience. The GES/CE Fire Protection Program Manager role significantly contributes to that mission by leading and executing engineering activities across a broad set of responsibilities as outlined below.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

The Fire Protection Program Manager is an engineering professional who, working with little or no supervision, applies advanced scientific and engineering knowledge, mathematics and ingenuity to complete complex assignments related to the Fire Protection Engineering discipline. A Fire Protection Program Manager has full knowledge of other related disciplines beyond their own.

Specific responsibilities include but are not limited to:

Technical / Design: Benchmarks internally and externally. Independently executes or directs others in the design of facilities/utilities/infrastructure systems, by applying novel and proven engineering concepts and techniques. Performs detailed analysis, communicates across functions and disciplines, and serves as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) in design reviews.

Project Management: Identifies, plans and executes projects of varying degrees of complexity within engineering specialty, requiring custom risk-managed execution plans. Works with the client and cross-functional stakeholders to establish scope, cost and schedule on multiple projects. Independently performs economic analysis and feasibility studies related to complex and often multiple competing project alternatives. Manages multiple projects, often concurrently, maintaining project controls and reporting for scope, cost and schedule. Responsible for achieving the projects’ financial targets in support of business objectives.

Problem Solving / Innovation: Creates or coordinates design solutions for novel or complex problems focusing on cost-benefit, integrating regulatory needs (e.g. NFPA, Fire Code, Building Code, and Factory Mutual (FM) requirements) and operational needs (e.g. processes, materials, and people requirements). Structures studies to address cross-disciplinary and cross-functional issues and arrive at optimal solutions.

Organizational Interface: Mentors others by sharing technical knowledge and providing guidance. Where appropriate, provides tasks and project assignment opportunities for employee development and evaluates performance. Represents the organization as the prime technical contact, interacting with senior management and external parties on complex technical matters often requiring coordination between organizations. Conveys information effectively through formal and informal means including proposals, reports, design documentation, and presents to senior executive leadership. Submits articles for internal or external publication.

Compliance: Responsible for compliance with applicable Corporate and Divisional policies, procedures, and standards for Quality, Environmental, Health, Safety and Energy (EHS&E), Abbott Engineering Standards (AES), and other governance areas as applicable.

Additional Responsibilities May Include: Responsible for all matters pertaining the Fire Protection Engineering discipline as the global SME. Participates in internal cross-divisional teams to develop new, or revise existing, procedures and standards, and provides training. Directs the efforts of others such as engineers, technicians and outside resources. Crafts and submits Requests for Capital Expenditures (RCEs), safety/quality checklists, executive presentations, and projects financial reports. Resolves problems and crisis situations requiring assertive decisions and hands-on rapid implementation, by leveraging technical training and experience. Represents engineering on corporate and division initiatives.

EDUCATION / EXPERIENCE / SKILLS

B.S. degree in Fire Protection Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or related discipline is required.

M.S. degree in Fire Protection Engineering is required if B.S. degree is not in Fire Protection Engineering.

Professional Engineer (PE) license is a plus.

Certifications: Certified Fire Protection Specialist (CFPS) is required.

Professional Affiliations: SFPE or NFPA membership is a plus.

Minimum of 12 years of experience in the design and deployment of fire protection solutions across building facilities and utilities systems.

Mastery of applicable codes, including NFPA (National Fire Protection Association), NEC (National Electrical Code), IFC (International Fire Code), IBC (International Building Code), and other local, national, and international regulatory requirements.

Experience with Fire Prevention/Detection/Suppression, Risk Management, and Loss Prevention.

Experience with fire protection systems including gas, water, pre-action, foam, and clean agent.

Experience with seismic bracing of fire protection systems.

Experience with underground fire mains, lead-ins, piping, and thrust blocks.

Experience with flammable liquids and hazardous materials storage, and maximum allowable quantities.

Experience with warehouses including flue spacing, high density storage, in-rack sprinklers, and commodity classifications.

Experience with Performance-Based Design (PBD) approach.

Experience with Life Safety and Egress analysis.

Experience with fire alarm, smoke detection, and smoke control systems.

Experience with Factory Mutual (FM) requirements, Plan Reviews, and inspection reports/responses.

Experience assessing the design and performance of fire protection and life safety systems on existing facilities, identifying gaps versus regulatory requirements and AES, and developing remediation plans.

Experience supporting construction and commissioning testing of fire protection and life safety systems.

Experience with fire/explosion protection on manufacturing processes is desired but not required.

Experience in regulated industries (e.g. medical device, pharmaceutical, or nutritional)

Excellent leadership, problem-solving, interpersonal, presentation, and communication skills.

Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced environment.

Proficiency in MS Project/Word/Excel/PowerPoint/Outlook, AutoCAD, SAP, Smartsheet, and Bluebeam.

Proven track record of successful execution throughout the entire project lifecycle: Feasibility –> Concept –> Design –> Construction –> Commissioning & Qualification –> Turnover –> Closeout.

Commitment to safety, quality and regulatory compliance.

Data Analytics is one of the rapidly growing fields in GPU accelerated computing.
